mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tours (title, description, destination, catalogueId, regularPrice, premiumPrice, createdBy) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{destination}, #{catalogueId}, #{regularPrice}, #{premiumPrice}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update:
UPDATE tours
title = #{title},
description = #{description},
destination = #{destination},
catalogueId = #{catalogueId},
regularPrice = #{regularPrice},
premiumPrice = #{premiumPrice},
WHERE tourId = #{tourId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.tourId, t.catalogueId, t.title, t.destination, t.description, t.regularPrice, t.premiumPrice, t.createdBy FROM tours t WHERE t.tourId = #{tourId}
SELECT t.tourId, t.catalogueId, t.title, t.destination, t.description, t.regularPrice, t.premiumPrice, t.createdBy FROM tours t WHERE t.catalogueId = #{catalogueId} ORDER BY t.updateTime
